Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two distinct enrichment strategies: TurboID proximity labeling and FLAG-tag affinity purification. Acquisition is DDA (TopN/Target value of 3000 ions) on an LTQ Orbitrap Elite. No specific labeling reagents (TMT/SILAC) are mentioned for the MS analysis, and SEQUEST search against UniProt typically implies LFQ in this context.

scope: In order to identify the binding proteins of VHL and BICD2, we enriched their binding proteins by TurboID-based proximity labeling technology and Flag pull-down assay, and performed mass spectrum analysis.

the supernatants were incubated with Streptavidin magnetic beads (Beaverbio, 22305-1) overnight at 4 °C. Subsequently, the beads were washed... Finally, biotinylated proteins were eluted by boiling the beads

the supernatants were enriched with anti-FLAG M2 beads (Sigma, F2426) at 4 °C overnight. The binding components were eluted with 3×FLAG peptide (Sigma, F4799). The samples were subjected to NuPAGE 4–12% gel (Invitrogen) and sliver staining (Pierce, 24612). The excised gel segments were subjected to mass spectrum analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material isolated via TurboID-based proximity labeling (streptavidin capture) and FLAG pull-down assays, both of which are affinity-purification methods.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (TurboID and Flag pull-down) specifically compares the interactomes of overexpressed VHL and BICD2 against mock controls in HEK293T cells. While the broader study involves CaOx crystals, Vhl+/- mice, and Vemurafenib, these were not the variables used in the MS-analyzed samples described in the PRIDE metadata and Methods (TurboID/Flag pull-down sections).
